message:
HIA: integrate native source build and admission owners

Bind source admission, source-build policy and packer, release selection, publication custody, and complete installed asset groups to the native HIA components. Preserve strict image/source receipts and add malformed-receipt rejection controls.

Publish the exact generated tree from source harness run 43153009209: all 72 generators and 660 source controls passed on CPython 3.14.4. The complete 3,084-file tree was independently recomputed as 79843bddc6df7306299f0be6475a2fcd187b4d97. The first harness failure and fixture-only correction remain separately retained.

Current-source cold, full qualification, default selection, and legacy removal remain separate gates. No defaults or legacy owners are removed by this source integration.
